caveats: Three repetitions support median and range only; no p95 or significance claim.
The reduced app composition excludes media services and workers.
HTTP overlap and app-side stream-pull intervals are separate; stream-pull spans include DB fetch and CSV encoding.
A single SELECT uses one Read Committed snapshot; the RC/RR multi-SELECT probe is a separate experiment.
Per-app cgroup memory.peak was not retained before app containers were removed; ru_maxrss exceeded the nominal 256 MiB Docker memory setting, so charged-memory use cannot be inferred from RSS.
The initial disposable database exited with code 1 during isolation setup; cause unresolved. Five absent isolation trials ran in a fresh bounded database, without repeating HTTP samples.

environment.authentication: synthetic operator credential; actual HTTP login and cookie guard used
environment.composition: real FastAPI session and export routers, real AuthService and Database; no media services

database.data_storage: task-owned database container tmpfs, capped at 256MiB
database.host_publish: none; migration and seed utilities share the private network
database.name: gw_events_bench_4bd6ab61

environment.download: stdlib HTTP client streams response to a temporary file; no response.read() for full body
environment.postgresql_server_version: PostgreSQL 17.8 (Debian 17.8-1.pgdg12+1) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 12.2.0-14+deb12u1) 12.2.0, 64-bit

resource_limits.aggregate_database_connections: <=4; setup utility is sequential and app pool caps at three

environment.rss: application resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss in Linux KiB; baseline is marked after login
